# German and French landing-page screenshots

Captured by `npm run check:browser` in Chromium at 390 × 900 and 1280 × 900,
with the light theme and reduced motion. The images show the complete page.
The release lookup is fixed to `v0.4.0` for the capture.

The same check covers all 16 marketing routes in four languages at 320, 390,
768, 1024, 1280 and 1440 pixels with JavaScript, and at 390 and 1280 pixels
without it. Both themes are checked: 256 layout readings. It also checks
language switches, mobile navigation, copy status, install tabs, the player
and refusal of missing translations. CI retains fresh light/dark screenshots
and the readings as the `localization-browser-checks` artifact.
